statuses.VALID: Pose and required checks are sufficiently reliable for downstream use.
statuses.UNRELIABLE: A required perception/pose estimate failed its reliability gate.
statuses.MANUAL_INSPECTION: Automatic compliance decision is not safe; human review required.
statuses.SYSTEM_ERROR: Pipeline/inference/input/system failure; result must not be consumed as a valid assessment.

rules: Never encode a missing pose as a valid zero-valued pose.
Downstream consumers must branch on status and failure_reason.
UNRELIABLE pose prevents geometry-dependent automatic load verdicts.
SYSTEM_ERROR is distinct from a valid image with uncertain perception.
